cases.description: A workspace that lacks root AGENTS.md should trigger rebuild-required routing instead of silently continuing.
A landed workspace with generator-version mismatch should route into takeover rather than the full default interview.
Unexpected root-level files should trip the structure gate and require explicit confirmation.
Git governance must reject linked or additional worktrees and reserved worktree directories without confirmation or profile bypasses.
tests, smoke*, reports, and runs must stay at the work-folder root and be blocked when nested under the primary skill or engineering directory.
v1.0.0 removes evolution commands and contracts; docs, eval harness, and manage_docs CLI must all agree that the feature is no longer supported.
v1.1.0 removes governed experience updates; scaffold and fifth handoff must avoid docs/experience requests while verify passes and memory records handoffs.
Generic target skills should pass core audit checks without inheriting agents-md-generator-only contracts.
Generic evaluate failures should expose machine-readable target-repo behavior classification.
Install validation must reject a release whose SKILL.md references missing formal content.
Installable skill releases must include skill-local evals while still rejecting tests, smoke*, reports, runs, and other work-folder artifacts.
Release sanitization must preserve Python regex constants while still redacting real token assignments and leaving dist scripts compilable.
Governance-sensitive script and version changes must require companion tests, docs, eval coverage, and release records, while non-release review dispatch stays optional.

Strong-control profile writes must block until final extra requirements are recorded and approved subagent design-review evidence with matching hashes is supplied, but read_only interviews must complete without reviewer dispatch until explicitly escalated.

The formal skill-effectiveness runner and runtime helper must live under scripts/python/verify/, tests/run_skill_evals.py must remain only a compatibility wrapper, and stale test-only fixtures must not be required for installed validation.
Source governance must enforce the 64KB UTF-8 size limit, preserve decomposition-plan exceptions, skip excluded roots, and block one-line or minified unreadable source.
sync-root-agents must repair both root metadata and the managed Control Profile version line so verify/manage_docs guidance does not point users at a partial fix.
When the agents-md-generator source repository is preparing a new release, render_agents must use the source VERSION for root metadata even if the installed skill is still stale.

Generated root AGENTS.md must include Coding Behavior Baseline language skill routing, route Python work to readable-python-generator, route bat/cmd, shell/bash, PowerShell, and Tcl script work to readable-script-generator, keep legacy installed versions on compatibility wording while strict versions enforce the dual-skill wording, write coding_behavior.language_skill_routing config, and verification must reject missing or weakened routing rules.

Generated root AGENTS.md must include a configurable Script Output Policy, write script_output_policy config with extensible Kinds, and verification must reject missing or weakened output format rules.
Default conversation language governance must also lock Plan Mode `<proposed_plan>` body text, and verification must reject managed roots that keep only the generic reply-language rule.
Explicit Codex token usage requests must route to the internal codex_token_usage_review.py tool, and the tool must refuse to run when the active environment cannot resolve a Codex sessions directory.
External workspaces must call installed agents-md-generator governance runtime commands and must reject project-local vendored governance script commands.
Installed agents-md-generator runtime verification must still accept repo-local governance commands when the target is the agents-md-generator source owner repository.
Governed handoff documents must keep strict current and history naming, block silent scaffold masking, and require explicit repair for renamed files.
Workspace engineering configs must live under .settings, remote review must block all .local.json files, and generated governance must state the local/remote naming contract.

Governance CLI entrypoints must start cleanly, current-workspace planning triggers must remain documented, external workspaces must use installed runtime commands, and remote .local.json workspace settings must be blocked.

Global task-entry governance must prefer reuse, include v3 Coding Behavior Baseline, Comments And Documentation, Environment And Dependency Safety, Markdown documentation formulas, and installed skill protection, avoid asking difficulty/scale for every task, preserve explicit or contextual user ratings, and trigger stricter planning/reuse research for hell or nightmare work.

Strong-control memory governance must block missing or disabled memory, require authorized creation, bootstrap exact-cwd Codex sessions into timestamped summaries, and pass only after memory verification is complete.
